etymologies.etymologyHTML: Borrowed from Angloromani pal (“brother, friend”), from Romani phral (“brother”), from Sanskrit भ्रातृ (bhrātṛ, “brother”). Doublet of bhai, brother, frater, and friar.

definitions.definition: (colloquial) A friend, buddy, mate, cobber; someone to hang around with.
(colloquial) An informal term of address, often used ironically in a hostile way.
